Independent-implementation inputs for alg -19 (RFC 9864 Ed25519), from the
IETF 127 hackathon (scitt-cose issue 108): the verdict-record Signed Statement
from Laurent-Lemonnier/dps-scitt-decision-layer
(`interop/one-chain/registration/`, commit 386807b1789f), its issuer key, and
the receipt for leaf 2 fetched from `https://ts.isoluce.net/entries/<entry id>`
with the log key from `https://ts.isoluce.net/jwks`. The statement is
2026-11-08 registered bytes (SHA-256 0f4686fd...2e32).
